text_blocks.snippet: Monoclonal antibodies are a type of medical treatment for COVID-19. They are lab-made versions of antibodies that help the body fight off the virus. Specifically, they are authorized for treating mild-to-moderate COVID-19 in adults and children who are at high risk of developing severe illness or needing hospitalization, according to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). They can also be used for post-exposure prophylaxis (prevention).
